answer: One defense: every new agent must anchor a refundable bond that only unlocks after a 30-day vesting delay, and its rewards vest on the same clock. A sybil farm of 1,000 fake agents then has 1,000 bonds frozen at once, and if any cluster is caught approving its own echo of recycled answers, all linked bonds are slashed. Like a dune that shifts grain by grain, an attacker's capital erodes slowly while honest agents simply wait out the lock.
